catalog.title: Where shall we go?

about.title: Smart table booking in restaurants
about.subtitle: TableMint helps guests effortlessly discover cozy dining spots and book tables online, while empowering restaurants with automated seating and menu management.
about.statOverlapsLabel: Risk of double bookings or overlaps
about.featureGuestsDesc: Browse up-to-date menus with prices in KGS, pick convenient slots, and book a table in seconds with instant confirmation codes.
about.featureOverlapsDesc: Our smart seating engine allocates tables perfectly tailored to your party size, eliminating any chance of double bookings.
about.featureOwnersDesc: A streamlined partner cabinet: customizable opening hours, interactive table management, live menu editing, and detailed booking analytics.
about.featureBotDesc: Guests can explore menus and complete reservations directly inside Telegram without installing third-party apps.
about.stepsSubtitle: Just 3 simple steps to a wonderful evening
about.step1Desc: Explore city venues, ambient photos, operating hours, and full menus with current pricing.
about.step2Desc: The platform displays available 30-minute slots and automatically reserves the optimal table.
about.step3Desc: Receive a unique booking reference code with full flexibility to reschedule or cancel anytime.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to discover great dining spots?
about.ctaSubtitle: Reserve a table at your favorite restaurant today.
